purpose: One generated prop per hard-surface category of Elwynn's most-placed doodads (sandbox-classic-pack schema-15 pack, ranked by placements); a candidate pool and WI 2092's test input, not final art.

provisional.style: unanchored: no style guide, anchor set or style LoRA exists until asset-harness WI 2093; the prompts here are re-run once it lands
provisional.licence: conditional: the 3D lane is conditional until WI 1749's O1 (the DINOv3 conditioner's source) and O2 (the credit line); nothing from this batch ships before both are decided

frame: Three-quarter view from slightly above, the whole object in frame and centred, on a plain light grey background, soft even studio light, a stylised hand-painted fantasy game prop, clean readable shapes.
size_note: longest: the category's longest horizontal side in yards, the normaliser's scale (WI 2091); a guess from the classic pack's models of the same kind, not a measurement of each
